slides.title: Internet Services — Email & Search 📧
slides.text: Email lets you send and receive electronic messages instantly across the Internet! Search engines like Google help you find information on any topic instantly.
slides.spoken: Email lets you send and receive electronic messages instantly across the Internet! Search engines like Google help you find information on any topic instantly.

slides.title: Online Shopping, E-Learning & Cloud 🛒
slides.text: Online shopping lets you buy goods from websites like Amazon and Flipkart. E-learning brings education home via BYJU's or DIKSHA. Cloud storage keeps files safe on remote servers!
slides.spoken: Online shopping lets you buy goods from websites like Amazon and Flipkart. E-learning brings education home. Cloud storage keeps files safe on remote servers!

slides.title: Composing & Sending Emails ✉️
slides.text: To send an email, fill in the To address, write a clear Subject, type the body message, attach files if needed with the paperclip icon, and click Send! Received mail goes to your Inbox.
slides.spoken: To send an email, fill in the To address, write a clear Subject, type the body message, attach files with the paperclip icon, and click Send!

slides.title: Internet Safety & Strong Passwords 🛡️
slides.text: Never share your full name, home address, phone number, or school name online. Use strong passwords with mixed letters and numbers, and never share them with anyone!
slides.spoken: Never share your full name, home address, phone number, or school name online. Use strong passwords with mixed letters and numbers, and never share them with anyone!

slides.title: LOGO REPEAT Command & Shapes 🐢
slides.text: The LOGO REPEAT command runs instructions multiple times! A square uses REPEAT 4 [FD 100 RT 90]. The turning angle for any regular polygon is 360 divided by the number of sides.
slides.spoken: The LOGO REPEAT command runs instructions multiple times! A square uses REPEAT 4 [FD 100 RT 90]. The turning angle for any regular polygon is 360 divided by the number of sides.

challenges.question: Which Internet service allows you to send and receive electronic messages almost instantly?
options: Email
Cloud storage
Online shopping
challenges.hint: Think: what electronic service replaced paper letters for fast messaging?
challenges.misconception: Email is short for electronic mail, used for sending messages instantly over the Internet. Cloud storage is for saving files, and online shopping is for buying goods!

options: Cloud storage
Email

challenges.question: Drag each Internet service to its correct definition!
challenges.hint: Match Email to messaging, Search to finding info, Shopping to buying goods, E-learning to studying online, and Cloud to saving files!
challenges.misconception: Remember each Internet service has a specific job: Email sends messages, Search finds info, Online shopping buys products, E-learning teaches online, and Cloud storage saves files on remote servers.

challenges.question: What is an email ATTACHMENT?
challenges.answer: A separate file like a picture or document sent along with an email message
options: A separate file like a picture or document sent along with an email message
The email subject line title
The recipient email address in the To field
challenges.hint: Think: what do you attach using a paperclip icon when emailing a photo?
challenges.misconception: An attachment is NOT the subject line or address! It is a separate file (like a photo or PDF worksheet) that travels alongside your email message.

challenges.question: Drag each email part to its correct description!
challenges.hint: Match To to recipient address, Subject to title, Body to message text, and Attachment to file!
challenges.misconception: Remember: The To field holds the recipient address, Subject is the short title, Body is the main message text, and Attachment is the extra file sent with the email.

challenges.question: Which of these is a safe Internet practice?
challenges.answer: Use strong passwords with mixed letters and numbers and keep them secret
options: Use strong passwords with mixed letters and numbers and keep them secret
Share your home address and phone number with online strangers
Write your password on a paper on your desk for everyone to see
challenges.hint: Think: should you share personal details or keep passwords secure?
challenges.misconception: Sharing personal information or writing passwords where others can see them is unsafe! Always use strong passwords with mixed letters and numbers and keep them completely secret.

challenges.question: Sort these practices into Safe or Unsafe Internet habits!
challenges.hint: Strong passwords and asking adults are Safe. Sharing addresses and passwords are Unsafe!
challenges.misconception: Remember: Using strong passwords and keeping personal details private are safe habits. Sharing passwords or giving your home address to strangers online are major cyber safety risks.

challenges.question: In LOGO programming, what does the REPEAT command do?
challenges.answer: Runs a set of commands inside brackets multiple times without rewriting them
options: Runs a set of commands inside brackets multiple times without rewriting them
Deletes all turtle drawings from the screen
Saves the computer program file to cloud storage
challenges.hint: Think: what does 'repeat' mean in daily life when doing an action over and over?
challenges.misconception: The REPEAT command does NOT delete drawings or save files! It is a loop construct that executes a block of commands multiple times efficiently.

challenges.question: Drag each LOGO REPEAT command to the shape it draws!
challenges.hint: Square is REPEAT 4, Triangle is REPEAT 3, Hexagon is REPEAT 6, and Circle is REPEAT 360!
challenges.misconception: Remember the 360 divided by sides rule: Square has 4 sides (90° turn), Triangle has 3 sides (120° turn), Hexagon has 6 sides (60° turn), and Circle uses 360 tiny steps!
